notes: New Media tab: make folders of clips and pick one straight from Create - your saved clip sets became folders automatically. Video previews always show something useful now (the caption when no preview exists), the update bar got a cleaner look with a real progress bar, and everything loads faster.
_urls: urls are GitHub Release assets (stable, public, direct .exe/.dmg) and sha256 pins the exact binary - the 2.9.8+ updater verifies the download against it before offering to install. Assets use customer-friendly names (Remixa-Windows.exe / Remixa-Mac.dmg); the release TAG carries the version. Mac dmg is signed + notarized + stapled (no Gatekeeper warning) from the cloud-Mac CI. Both platforms current as of 2.9.50.
